headline: Weathered Expanse Shatters into Wasteland as Northern Battlegrounds Churn
war_summary: The past three hours brought sharp upheavals to the Weathered Expanse, where the battlefield devolved into widespread ruin; five strategic bases now lie abandoned in no-man's-land, while Warden forces reclaimed three positions, leaving Colonials reduced to a single outpost following five fresh transactions. Along the Nevish Line, intense combat erupted anew, logging four base transfers in two hours as Warden casualties climbed to nearly twelve hundred against nearly six hundred Colonial dead. Callahan's Passage registered two further clashes over Crumbling Post, yet Warden command maintains hold over all ten sector strongholds amid heavy mutual slaughter. By contrast, strategic lines held steady in Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow, with no base ownership changes recorded over the past two hours, even as casualty rates accelerated during the latest hour. Mooring County also remained tactically quiet, preserving its lone Colonial enclave at The Wind Hills. Meanwhile, eastern fighting flared on the Stlican Shelf, where sudden surges in enlistments and casualties suggest mounting pressure along the fortified perimeter.
